newsitem.title: DUBAI: Etisalat leads United Arab Emirates stocks up.
newsitem.headline: Etisalat leads United Arab Emirates stocks up.

text.p: Trade on the unofficial United Arab Emirates stock market picked up in the week to Thursday, with many shares rising on expectations of good end-year results.
The National Bank of Abu Dhabi (NBAD) 27-share index rose 12.62 points to 2,517.37 from 2,504.75.

Dealers said the biggest gainer was telecommunications firm Etisalat, which shot up 17 percent to 1,120 dirhams from 960 after it announced a 25 dirham cash dividend for the second half of 1996 and a one-for-four bonus share issue.
They said bank shares were mostly higher as investors expected good 1996 results.
National Bank of Abu Dhabi and Union National Bank shares were up five dirhams each at 455 and 335 respectively.

Insurance companies also scored well. Abu Dhabi National Insurance gained 10 dirhams to 1,060, Al-Ain al-Ahlia Insurance and al-Dhafra Insurance were up five dirhams each at 1,250 and 885 respectively.
